{{Short description|Uruguayan mathematician (born 1956)}}
'''Eleonora Dolores Catsigeras García''' (born 1956) is a Uruguayan mathematician who specializes in [[Dynamical system|dynamical systems]] and is a winner of the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science]] in 2014, with her project ''Neurodynamics''.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=2014 |title=Eleonora Catsigeras es la ganadora del Premio Nacional L´Oreal-UNESCO Uruguay 2014 "Por las Mujeres en la Ciencia" |work=UNESCO |url=https://www.fing.edu.uy/~eleonora/Recopilacion/Archivos/Divulgacion/2014_UNESCO-Setiembre.pdf |archive-date=2023-11-19 |access-date=2023-11-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231119124810/https://www.fing.edu.uy/~eleonora/Recopilacion/Archivos/Divulgacion/2014_UNESCO-Setiembre.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=WSEAS |url=https://www.wseas.org/cms.action?id=9276 |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=www.wseas.org}}</ref> She completed the Doctorate in Sciences at the National Institute of Pure and Applied Mathematics in Rio de Janeiro since 1991, obtaining the title in 1995.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-08-02 |title=Eleonora Catsigeras, ganadora de "Por las mujeres en la Ciencia" - EME de Mujer |url=http://uy.emedemujer.com/actualidad/eleonora-catsigeras-ganadora-de-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia/ |access-date=2023-11-19 |url-status=usurped |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160802044238/http://uy.emedemujer.com/actualidad/eleonora-catsigeras-ganadora-de-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia/ |archive-date=2016-08-02 }}</ref> She later began working as a teacher at the Institute of Mathematics and Statistics of the [[University of the Republic (Uruguay)|University of the Republic]], where she became professor.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Científica uruguaya recibe USD 20 mil del premio L'Oréal-Unesco |url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Ciencia-y-Tecnologia/Cientifica-uruguaya-recibe-USD-20-mil-del-premio-L-Oreal-Unesco-uc247300 |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=Montevideo Portal |language=es |archive-date=2023-11-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231119124157/https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Ciencia-y-Tecnologia/Cientifica-uruguaya-recibe-USD-20-mil-del-premio-L-Oreal-Unesco-uc247300 |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Awards ==

* Special Mention at the Pedeciba-UNDP Caldeyro Barcia Awards (1999)<ref name=":1" />
* [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L'Oréal-UNESCO Award for Women in Science]] (2014)<ref name=":0" />
